Subject: Question about group tickets for the Halversen Museum

We're a group of eight planning to visit the Halversen Museum on the second Saturday of June, and I saw that your booking page has a virtual assistant that handles group rates. I tried it twice and it kept quoting the individual adult price, so I wanted to ask a person directly: is there a group discount for parties of eight or more, and does it need to be booked in advance? We'd also like to know whether the special exhibition is included in the entry fee, since a couple of us have already seen the permanent collection. If the group rate only applies on weekdays, please let me know, because we could shift the date. Thanks for any help you can give.

Subject: Status of the Lindqvist brochure translation

Hello, I'm writing about the Swedish-to-English translation of the Lindqvist furniture brochure we commissioned last month (order ref. TR-4471). Our account page shows an automated status tool that still lists the project as "in review," but the delivery date we agreed was the 20th, and I haven't received any files yet.

Could you confirm which stage the translation is actually at, and whether the reviewer has flagged anything that needs input from us? We have a print slot booked for the 27th, so I'd like to understand the realistic timeline. If the terminology glossary we sent is causing delays, we can approve the alternative terms your translator suggested.

One more thing: our marketing lead will be out of office from Friday, so any queries about the final wording should come to me directly rather than to her. Thanks very much for your help — happy to jump on a call if that's easier.

Subject: Query about the Ordway Hall audio guide translation

We're preparing a Polish version of the Ordway Hall audio guide for the autumn season, and the draft you sent last week looks good overall. I ran the opening section through your online translation checker and it flagged two exhibit names as inconsistent, which I think is just because the checker doesn't know our house style — could a human translator take a quick look? The narration is being recorded on the 12th, so we'd ideally like the confirmed script a few days before then. Also, the export tool on your portal keeps dropping the timecodes when I download the file; is there a setting I'm missing? Apart from that, the translator's notes on the Latin inscriptions were genuinely helpful. Let me know what's realistic and whether there's an extra fee for the review, and I'll get it approved on our side.
